purpose: Teach: 浮遊/社会民主党/脱走/懲罰/移送/送還/駆逐/政務

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、工場内の浮遊粉塵を管理しろ
lines.en: I want the factory's airborne particulate properly managed.
lines.style: Measured, businesslike. Lean forward slightly on the imperative. Clear enunciation. No room for negotiation. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社会民主党との対話の場も設けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll also establish a formal dialogue with the relevant agencies.
lines.style: Efficient, attentive. Quick acknowledgement at the start. Steady pace throughout. Demonstrates he's already thinking through implementation details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、機密情報の脱走を厳重に防げ
lines.en: And I want our proprietary information protected with absolute rigor.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. Slight weight on 'absolute.' Eye contact. Not a suggestion. The tone of someone who's seen breaches before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。違反社員の懲罰委員会を設置しました
lines.en: Understood. We've established a disciplinary committee to address any violations.
lines.style: Assured, professional. Brief pause after the acknowledgement to signal completion of one task before the next. Matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人材移送のコストを最適化しろ
lines.en: Look into optimizing the costs of personnel deployment across our operations.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Slight lift at the end—this is an area with room for judgment. Expecting Kenji to do the thinking, not just execute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。違法滞在事案には送還手続を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We're accelerating the repatriation process for those with irregular status.
lines.style: Steady, precise. No hesitation. Speaking as though this is already underway. Professional detachment—a difficult task stated plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合を駆逐するより共存を考えろ
lines.en: Rather than trying to eliminate competitors, consider how we might coexist with them.
lines.style: Thoughtful shift in tone. Slower, more contemplative. This is counsel, not a directive. Leaning back slightly. Inviting consideration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。政務関連の渉外を強化しております
lines.en: Understood. We're strengthening our government relations to support that direction.
lines.style: Decisive close. Slight formality marking the end of the meeting. Confident nod. Demonstrates alignment and preparedness to execute the new strategy.
